messages.subject: Setting Rapache
parts:

at URL http://localhost/rapache. But it shows a blank screen when I
try to execute test.R at http://localhost/rscripts/ with Apaches
settings:

<Directory /srv/home/rscripts/>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

That directory contains the file test.R with script:

handler <- function(r){
apache.write(r,"<h1>hello world</h1>")
OK
}

What have I done wrong? Help please.

messages.author: 71881ca474dcdfb1
messages.subject: Re: Setting Rapache
parts:
Sergey,

here are my setting in the httpd.conf file:

LoadModule R_module /usr/libexec/apache2/mod_R.so
ROutputErrors

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

<Directory /Library/WebServer/Documents/rscripts>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

<Directory /Library/WebServer/Documents/brew>

SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>
Be sure, that you installed brew package in R.

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Setting Rapache
parts:
Look for a DefaultType directive somewhere in your apache conf. It's
probably set to text/plain. If you change this to text/html, then the
errors will be rendered correctly.

Jeff
